The orthorhombic HoMg₂Sn structure (space group Amm2, No. 38) has 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Ho and Sn centers each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers also have 12 neighbors, with varying Ho, Mg, and Sn compositions. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Ho–Sn polyhedra share corners and faces.
